fundsInfo.title: How do funds work?
fundsInfo.description: Funds help you set aside money for a specific purpose, such as building improvements or unexpected expenses. Fund fees determine how much each home contributes.

create.title: 1. Give the fund a name
create.description: Choose Add Fund and enter a clear name, such as “Building improvements” or “Reserve”. Then continue to select its fees. You can also save a fund without fees and assign them later.

fees.title: 2. Link the fund fees
fees.description: Select the fees that should contribute to this fund. Only fund fees that are unassigned or already linked to this fund appear here. If none are available, create a fee of type Fund in the Fees section, then edit the fund to assign it.

homes.title: Which homes contribute?
homes.description: Homes contribute through the fees assigned to them. Set the amount and choose the homes when creating or editing a fee. While selecting fees for a fund, click a fee’s home count to see the homes it applies to.

table.title: What does the table show?
table.description: The Fees column shows how many fees are linked to each fund. A warning icon means no fees are assigned yet. Use the edit icon to link fees. The counter beside the Funds heading shows how many funds you have and the maximum allowed.

fundsInfo.note: You can edit a fund’s name and assigned fees later. To move a fee to another fund, first uncheck it in the current fund and save. Deleting a fund leaves its fees available to assign again.

fundInfo.title: Set This Fee as a Fund Fee
fundInfo.description: An amount that is set aside for future expenses or needs.
fundInfo.rule: Each property can have a different amount contributed to the fund.
fundInfo.note: It can be used for <u>planned</u> or <u>unexpected</u> expenses.

fundFee.rule: Each property can have only one fee for each fund.
fundFee.note: The fee is included in the current charge.

billInfo.title: How Do Bills Work?
billInfo.description: Add recurring condominium bills once, and they will automatically appear every month.

steps.add: Add a name, for example: "Electricity", "Water", or "Elevator".
steps.monthly: The bill is created and displayed every month.
steps.value: Only the amount needs to be entered when the bill is paid.

billInfo.note: You can edit or delete added bills at any time.

repairInfo.title: How do repairs work?
repairInfo.description: Plan a repair, decide which homes contribute and split their shares into manageable installments.

details.title: 1. Name and budget
details.description: Enter a clear name, such as “Roof repair”, and the total budget. Continue after the details have been checked.

homes.title: 2. Choose the participating homes
homes.description: Select the homes that will contribute. Use Select All if the repair applies to everyone.

distribution.title: Choose how to split the budget
distribution.description: Divide it equally among the selected homes, or enter a percentage for each home. The percentages must total 100%.

installments.title: Choose the number of installments
installments.description: This is how many parts each home’s share is split into. For example, a €300 share in 3 installments creates three payments of €100 for that home.

payments.title: Save and track payments
payments.description: Saving creates the repair and all installments for every selected home. They start unpaid. An installment is marked paid when its actual payment date is recorded.

repairInfo.note: Check the setup before saving. After a repair is created, only its name can be changed.
